- Open-minded, socially responsible
As food-consumers, we ask ourselves questions beyond the taste of food: do we only want organic-certified products available for purchase? What is more environment-friendly: a can or a glass bottle? - Multi-local mindset versus globalisation
We support an inclusive culture that favours social and cultural exchanges, seeking not to impose global, but multi-local solutions. Buy at the source to enjoy at the destination.
